notes: Material code is profiled as int but the cells are zero-padded ('000001'); it must be read as text so the SKU keeps its leading zeros per the contract.

The Material sheet (12 codes) and Prices sheet (13 rows / 12 codes) both key on Material code; code 000004 appears twice in Prices with different prices, and one of the Prices rows carries 9999 versus a 113–256 range for all others. No precedence rule exists for conflicting records, so the duplicate/outlier needs a business decision before joining master to prices.
Currency is established by the source (THB) and is not a VAT or price-inclusion statement; the export contains no VAT field, so price VAT inclusion is not determinable from this workbook.
Neither sheet contains stock quantities, promotions or category hierarchies, so no inventory/promotions/categories table was classified.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Material' is a two-column master list: a unique material code (12 distinct values across 12 rows, unique_ratio 1.0) plus a unique description. It carries no price or stock quantity, so it is the product master population.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Header 'Material code', unique per row (unique_ratio 1.0), values 000001–000012. Target requires a string SKU with leading zeros preserved, but the profile typed this column as int — it must be read as text (values display as '000001' etc.).

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Free-text description unique per material code ('Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11' …), matches the product master name field; no other candidate name column exists in the workbook.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Prices' links each material code to a selling price and a single-valued currency (THB on all 13 rows) — a price list keyed by the same material code as the Material sheet.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Same code domain as the Material sheet (000001–000012), foreign key to the product master; 12 distinct values over 13 rows, so one code repeats and must be reconciled with the master rather than treated as a new SKU.
